column1: # Rulings on hbtest assertions, statements and modules — every one a
# decision, with its reason (extract.py reads this file).
# ruling: quarantine   commented out on both sides
#         divergent    runs, but C# differs by design: does not gate
#         exclude      (module or routine) neither generated nor run

column3: reason

Harbour's own object runtime (hbclass.ch, __cls*, message sends): its CLASS definitions reach the transpiler as hbclass.ch's preprocessed expansion, which it cannot read, and C# classes do not use that runtime; the transpiler suite covers classes (Alex, 2026-09-19)
operator overloading on a class built at run time with HBClass():New() — the object runtime of the rt_class ruling
builds Main_OPOVERL's class with HBClass():New() and AddInline blocks on `self` — the object runtime of the rt_class ruling
